description: This PHP class defines the EmployeeJoinedDateChangedEvent within the OrangeHRM HRM system, encapsulating data related to an employee's join date change event.

classes.name: EmployeeJoinedDateChangedEvent
classes.description: An event class representing the change of an employee's join date, containing employee information and previous join date.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with an Employee object and an optional previous join date.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee object associated with this event.

methods.name: getPreviousJoinedDate
methods.description: Returns the previous join date if available.
